definitions.explanation: A narrow body of water extending into the land from a larger body of water, such as an arm of the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧{入|い}り{江|え}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Boats were anchored in the quiet inlet.

examples.japanese: {入|い}り{江|え}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やかで→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧⟦{透|す}き{通|とお}っていた→透き通る：14316_sukitooru⟧。
examples.english: The water in the cove was calm and clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{入|い}り{江|え}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良港|りょうこう}→良港：28679_ryoukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This inlet serves as a natural harbor.

notes:
{入|い}り{江|え} refers to an inlet, cove, or small bay. {入|い}り means 'entering' and {江|え} means 'bay/inlet.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {入|い}り{江|え}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter an inlet
- ⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧{入|い}り{江|え}: quiet cove
- {入|い}り{江|え}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧: back of an inlet

GEOGRAPHIC TERMS:
- ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧: bay (larger)
- {入|い}り{江|え}: inlet, cove (smaller)
- ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧: harbor, port
- ⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧: beach
- ⟦{岬|みさき}→岬：03911_misaki⟧: cape, headland

IN JAPANESE GEOGRAPHY:
- {入|い}り{江|え} is often part of place names
- Japan's complex coastline has many inlets and coves
